correctness.rationale: Exact conditioning separates initial infectious mass and latent mass entering during protection; integration gives saved transmission S(s). Its derivative has sign m_L-Phi(s), with strictly increasing Phi crossing m_L in (0,1) exactly once. The weighted truncated-exponential stochastic order of U_L proves strict duration monotonicity and limit endpoints. Equal-rate case and exact rational certificate are treated explicitly; 1,231 standalone checks passed and are acknowledged as finite evidence only.

evidence: Britton and Leskelä (2023), Theorem 2.1, proves unique maximum-level constant lockdowns for deterministic homogeneous SIR final incidence; its state equation has nonlinear susceptible depletion and no explicit latent single-person competing-risk law.

The indexed finite-generation branching result compares temporal control permutations in a branching process for finite-generation elimination and convex-order outbreak size, not time-continuous risk of first transmission to an individual after a latent clock.

The evolving-infectivity window result compares directional rearrangements across initial trait distributions, not a fixed-duration complete blockade for an irreversible two-stage clock with recovery.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A more general intervention set in a DIFFERENT nonlinear population dynamic does not imply a formula for this individual competing-risk model. The inspected broader SIR theorems characterize a lockdown shape and often a numerically determined time; they neither supply the same state law nor the strictly decreasing duration formula. Indexed related control results use different time variables and objectives.

evidence: Hollingsworth et al. (2011) and Di Lauro et al. (2021) optimize nonlinear-population epidemic mitigation objectives; they establish possible delayed interventions but do not claim every positive parameter gives unique delay for one latent source and one target.
Britton and Leskelä (2023) allow an all-control-class SIR final-incidence optimum but its state-space assumptions exclude the one-target latent-stage competing-risk model.
The indexed two-source path-contagion result maximizes an infection-by-deadline probability by moving initial source locations, not a no-deadline probability by moving a complete transmission block.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The final claim implies strictly positive optimal start for ALL finite block durations and a strictly decreasing duration-to-start map, plus an exact example. Qualitative prior observations that delayed lockdowns can be advantageous do not imply all these universal properties. Conversely, the present theorem does not claim the stronger population-wide SIR results; the two lines are separate rather than word variants.

evidence: published-finding corpus nearest indexed titles are reciprocal-latency deterministic SEIR overshoot, finite-generation branching convex order and evolving-infectivity contact-window rearrangement, not an individual continuous-time time-blocked competing risk.
Di Lauro et al., 2021, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1008763, sections 1–2 study population epidemic outcomes rather than the probability of transmission to one target.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A transient-state Markov forward equation is mathematically equivalent to a nonhomogeneous competing-risk model. Searches included both terminology families, plus quarantine and finite suppression windows. None of the materially inspected papers derives the displayed logarithmic optimizer for one source and target. Generic sliding-window integral optimization may be relevant but does not directly give the post-block recovery-memory term without a further derivation.

originality.rationale: The exact single-source/single-target exponential progression–transmission–recovery blockade law is not implied by the inspected nonlinear SIR population control results, by the stated related finite-generation branching-control or epidemic source-placement results. Direct searches using the claimed object, contact-window aliases, rate parameters and competing-risk formulation found no exact equivalent. Priority remains qualified: lack of a search hit is not a uniqueness proof; some plausible literature is inaccessible.
residual_risks: Historical equivalences in stochastic scheduling, reliability, finite Markov intervention and competing-risks theory cannot be excluded by semantic searching alone.
Full text of closest retrieved public mathematical records was inaccessible in the checked web route; comparison used their published indexed claims, not a fabricated full-document reading.
The single-target nonadaptive idealization has no validated clinical or policy transfer.

value.rationale: The full three-positive-rate and positive-duration global classification is a motivated natural question about an irreversible latent-to-infectious source and finite perfect contact prevention. The always strictly delayed unique optimum, its exact duration monotonicity and two limits reveal a general competing-risks scheduling mechanism without nonlinear herd immunity or population rebound. The exact probability gain of 17/648 gives substantive outcome separation; the result is a mathematical benchmark rather than clinical advice.
